name: button
title: Button
description: Primary, secondary, ghost, and destructive actions with hover, pressed, focus, and disabled states.

files.content:
<button class="kit-button" type="button">Save changes</button>
<button class="kit-button" type="button" data-variant="secondary">Preview</button>
<button class="kit-button" type="button" data-variant="ghost">Cancel</button>
<button class="kit-button" type="button" data-variant="destructive">Delete draft</button>
<button class="kit-button" type="button" disabled>Unavailable</button>
